title: Notify prescribed occupational respiratory diseases to the national registry
what: A prescribed medical practitioner who diagnoses a prescribed occupational respiratory disease notifies the national registry.

laws.title: National Occupational Respiratory Disease Registry Act 2023

sources.title: National Occupational Respiratory Disease Registry Act 2023
sources.quote: 14 Notifying information about prescribed occupational respiratory diseases—diagnosing prescribed medical practitioner Minimum notification information must be notified (1) If: (a) a prescribed medical practitioner diagnoses an individual with an occupational respiratory disease at or after the commencement of this Act; and (b) at the time the diagnosis is made, the occupational respiratory disease is a prescribed occupational respiratory disease; the prescribed medical practitioner must notify the Director-General of the CDC, in an approved form and by the time, or within the period, prescribed by the rules, of the minimum notification information in relation to the individual.
